definition.title: The Low-Tide Crossing
definition.briefing: Neris guides Reef Tender Pell across the low-tide flats. Tideborn cross mud and shallows without the usual slowdown. Clear each patrol and stay near Pell until he reaches the Coral Hold.
definition.successText: Pell reaches the Coral Hold with the tide ledger. Neris can plan an attack on the dry-land customs fort.
definition.failureText: Pell or Neris is lost on the flats. Reset and keep the formation beside the tender.

objectives.text: Escort convoy through all 3 checkpoints. Keep troops within seven tiles so the convoy advances.
Keep Neris Shellsong alive until the convoy arrives.

actions.text: Customs troops on the middle flat. They move slowly through the shallows.

actions.text: Use the wet flank and bring Pell through after their line turns.
